editions.title: Results from the weekend
editions.intro: This week already has two winners crowned: Marc Marquez in Malaysia and William Byron at Martinsville, while a Formula One title showdown in Mexico City and a drag racing night in Las Vegas still await.

items.headline: Mexico City Grand Prix
items.detail: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, Mexico · Sun 1 Nov
items.body: The season's final round runs on Sun 1 Nov, with qualifying on Sat 31 Oct at 21:00 UTC and the race itself starting at 20:00 UTC. Andrea Kimi Antonelli heads into Mexico City leading the championship by 123 points from George Russell.
facts: Qualifying Sat 31 Oct, 21:00 UTC
Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 123 points from George Russell

items.headline: Grand Prix of Malaysia
items.detail: Petronas Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia · Sun 1 Nov
items.body: Marc Marquez took victory by 4.2 seconds over Pedro Acosta, who also won Saturday's sprint and set a new lap record of 1:59.261. Alex Marquez completed the podium. Conditions were dry at Sepang with 36°C air and a 55°C track. Marquez's championship lead over Jorge Martin widened from 10 to 44 points, while Johann Zarco, Diogo Moreira, Joan Mir and Augusto Fernandez all failed to finish.

items.headline: Xfinity 500
items.body: William Byron won from eighth on the grid, leading 362 of 500 laps to take a 2.049-second margin over Chase Elliott, with Ty Gibbs third. His win lifted him from 11th to 9th in the Chase standings. Kyle Larson's lead over Christopher Bell narrowed from 73 to 67 points with one race remaining. Six cautions brought out 47 laps of caution racing, and Austin Cindric and Josh Bilicki failed to finish.

lastRaces.headline: Xfinity 500
lastRaces.body: William Byron claimed the Xfinity 500 at Martinsville, beating teammate Chase Elliott into second with Ty Gibbs third. Starting from eighth, he led 362 of 500 laps and swept stages one and two to win by just over two seconds. His performance narrowed Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell from 73 to 67 points, with a single race remaining.

lastRaces.headline: United States Grand Prix
lastRaces.detail: Circuit of the Americas, USA · Sun 25 Oct
lastRaces.body: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won from pole at Circuit of the Americas, finishing 13.1 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Max Verstappen third for Red Bull. The result extended his championship lead over George Russell to 123 points. Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap as Valtteri Bottas, Franco Colapinto and Oliver Bearman all failed to finish.

lastRaces.headline: Texas FallNationals
lastRaces.body: The Texas FallNationals brought drag racing to the Texas Motorplex in Ennis on Sunday 18 October. Competitors lined up across the season's classes for a weekend of quarter-mile action.

lastRaces.headline: Navarra
lastRaces.detail: Circuito de Navarra, Spain · Sun 18 Oct
lastRaces.body: Round six of the Clio Cup Series ran at the Circuito de Navarra in Spain on Sunday 18 October. Drivers took to the short Spanish circuit for another leg of the championship.

lastRaces.headline: Rally Italia Sardegna
lastRaces.body: World Rally Championship's Rally Italia Sardegna came around Alghero in Italy on Sunday 4 October, forming round 13 of the season. It was another demanding test across Sardinia for the leading crews as they pressed on through the latter half of the calendar.

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: IMSA's SportsCar Championship reaches its finale with the Motul Petit Le Mans at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta on Saturday 3 October. The endurance marathon has long stood as the series' crowning event, capping another demanding season of sports car racing.

lastRaces.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
lastRaces.body: The World Endurance Championship turned to Fuji Speedway in Japan on Sunday 27 September for the 6 Hours of Fuji. The circuit's steep climb past the summit has again defined this round, testing drivers and machines across a full endurance distance.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: Formula 2 brought its sprint and feature races to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September. The narrow street track threading the old city's walls offered another tight, technical test for the feeder series.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: Formula 3's tenth round came to Madrid, Spain on Sunday 13 September. The championship's Spanish round brought its racing to the city that weekend.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: Autodromo Nazionale Monza has hosted racing since 1922, its 5.793 km lap threading through 11 corners. The Porsche Supercup's seventh round ran here on Sunday 6 September as a double-header in Italy.
facts: 5.793 km lap, 11 corners, first raced 1922

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: IndyCar's season finale reached WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September. As the championship's final round of the year, it brought the season to a close at the venue.

lastRaces.headline: London E-Prix
lastRaces.body: Taylor Barnard won in London for DS Penske, completing a Mahindra Racing one-two as Nyck De Vries took second and Edoardo Mortara third. The result leaves Pascal Wehrlein five points clear at the top of the championship, ahead of Jake Dennis.
facts: Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis
